meta.name: paid-ads-creative
meta.description: Create grounded paid-media creative concepts, copy angles, refresh hypotheses, and measurable test briefs across advertising platforms. Use for ad copy, creative briefs, UGC concepts, headlines, creative fatigue, asset ideas, or a creative refresh.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出广告创意文案与可测的优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在管理付费广告,需要持续产出新创意来对抗素材疲劳。
copy.tagline_en: Produce ad creative copy and measurable optimization briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid media and need fresh ad creative to fight fatigue.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会基于你提供的实证素材(跑赢的广告、搜索词、客户研究等)产出3张独立“待审核”创意卡,内含假设、证据台账、钩子、CTA、视觉简报、成功指标和失败条件;不编造证言或数据,发布前核对平台规范并输出交接说明。
howto.when: 当你说到广告文案、创意简报、UGC概念等需求,或要求做创意刷新、诊断素材疲劳时触发;可传入平台、受众或campaign作为入口。

say.text: 基于这份销售通话记录,为跑鞋做3张创意卡
say.note: 会生成3张待审核概念卡

say.text: 判断这批广告是否素材疲劳,给刷新假设
为这个campaign写一句头条和主消息
say.note: 需你提供已验证的来源

howto.what_en: Claude creates three distinct concept cards from named evidence, each with hypothesis, claim ledger, hook, CTA, visual brief, metric, and failure condition. No fabricated proof; verifies platform specs before publishing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for ad copy, creative briefs, UGC concepts, headlines, fatigue diagnosis, or a creative refresh; pass a platform, audience, or campaign as entry hint.

say_en.text: Based on this sales call transcript, create 3 creative cards for our running shoes.
Check if these ads are fatigued and give refresh hypotheses.
say_en.note: Diagnoses with frequency, CTR, CPM first.

say_en.text: Write a headline and primary message for this campaign.
